body:
Audited repository definitions and consumer connections. All 151 production frontend modules and 66 Svelte components are connected, but unused internal tag machinery, five endpoint wrappers, card/store helpers, dormant props, dependency declarations and five CSS tokens remain.

Two OpenAPI registration operations lack handlers (synthetic release requests return 404). A synthetic CLI tag rename performs the change but reports RESULT_UNCERTAIN because it expects a command confirmation instead of workflow acceptance. Frontend checks, all-target Clippy and package/documentation validation pass.

Evidence and ordered cleanup recommendations: progress/2026-10-04-definition-usage-audit.md. No application code, scope or acceptance changed; existing concurrent work was preserved. The manual app was not rebuilt/restarted.

metadata.summary: Audited definition usage and API consumer connections
